_about: Written by the morning update. 'ticker' = the next 3 Texas events (shown under the logo unless the owner turns on 'Use my own ticker' in the editor). 'stories' go only in columns (left, center, right); the owner controls banner, feature and top links. Hidden story ids live in the site's hiddenAuto list. 'expired' = [{url, reason}] of column stories (owner's or auto) about games that are over; the front page hides those in left/center/right unless the owner listed the URL in keepUrls. Never banner/feature/top.
